FINDER F4c, ROUND 2: ONE CODEX REVIEW FINDING ON PR #969. Work on this branch only (feat/finder-f4c, head aaf2d368). Fix only this, with a regression test.

FINDING (verified by the reviewer). With VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED on, Compare's "Best Colony Potential" row and snapshotScoreSummary in apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/compare-metrics.ts (lines ~163 and ~306) read the tier from `entry.best_tier`. Real snapshots never have that field: normalizeAnySearchRow in apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts (around line 823) stores the overall-potential tier as `ranking_tier` with `score_kind: 'overall_potential'`, and snapshotFromExplore keeps it. So every pinned/compared Any-mode system loses its API tier; the existing tests pass only because they hand-build `best_tier`.

FIX. Read the overall-potential tier from the snapshot's normalized identity: when snapshotRankingIdentity(entry).score_kind is 'overall_potential', the overall tier is its ranking_tier. Keep reading `best_tier` too if a snapshot carries it (selected-fit rows that also carry the row's overall tier, or older saves), but never derive a tier from a score. Do not change client.ts or the stored format. Add tests that build the snapshot through the real path (normalizeAnySearchRow or an Any-mode ExploreSystem passed to snapshotFromExplore) and assert the tier appears in both the Compare row and the summary, plus one for a selected-fit snapshot so its overall tier is not taken from the selected fit's ranking_tier.

VALIDATION: apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, ESLint/Prettier on touched files; then `python -m pytest -q tests/ --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=tests/test_v3_spatial_pyramid.py --ignore=tests/test_admin_cache_truthfulness.py --ignore=tests/test_journal_commander_association.py` with no failures. Report results and every changed line.
